description: The term-model domain of a complete consistent set in the expanded language is nonempty; it contains the class of an added constant.
signature:

  {S : Set (L.Formula ℕ)} (hS : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent S)
  (hC : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.Complete S) :
  Nonempty (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.TermModel S hS hC)
